That's seriously what he called it?|Darth Marr|Capable of killing every living thing on this moon, as fuel for the Emperor's resurrection.|Lana Beniko|And housed within the very temple the Revanites are using as their base of operations.|attr=The coalition's leaders discuss the artifact|src=<ref name="Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Replica_Sacrificial_Sphere.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Replica of the Sacrificial Sphere]]
A large '''Sith artifact''' was installed in the upper levels of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The artifact was, with the accompanying ritual, capable of consuming all life on Yavin 4, and thus the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] sought to use it as a failsafe in case his [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|host body]] was [[Death/Legends|slain]]. The mad [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] seized control of the artifact and tried to resurrect the Emperor in order to kill him, but the forces of the temporarily-allied [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stormed the temple and destroyed the artifact before the ritual was completed.
